notes: Book chapter (InTech) with an experimental section and its own data, so not a review. I1: the paper does not use the word volumetric; the H2 isotherms were measured on a Micromeritics-type ASAP 2050 gas-sorption analyzer (quantity adsorbed vs pressure, 77 K, 0-10 bar), which is a static volumetric instrument, so I1 is taken as met on that basis. Table 3 gives H2 uptake at 10 bar and 77 K for CMK-1 (2.1 wt%), Zn-CMK-1 (4.4) and Ni-CMK-1 (2.4); Figure 25 plots Ads./Des. isotherms for CMK-1, Zn-CMK-1, Ni-CMK-1, CMK-3, Pt-CMK-3, V-CMK-3 and TiO2-CMK-3. Carbon sorbents: CMK-1 and CMK-3 and their metal-modified forms (metal loadings about 1-5.5 wt%; EDS for Ni-CMK-1 gives 94.1 wt% C, p. 72). Surface areas come from N2 isotherms at 77 K on the same samples (Section 2.8, Tables 3 and 4; Table 4 footnote says SBET is the BET surface area). The text cites the authors' earlier papers [12], [13] for the syntheses but nowhere states that its H2 uptake values were published before, so duplicate_data is not applied. record.json is_retracted is false and the text has no retraction notice.
